acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retained; it is the closest existing test for direct workflow/context authority, but cannot prove full untruncated controlling-byte visibility.
Retained; registry and roster non-drift remains necessary.
Retained; two-source provenance remains necessary but does not cure the broader future-memory provenance gap.
Retained; authenticated observations are necessary but guard identity and independent conformance remain unresolved.
Retained; synthetic matcher coverage remains necessary but cannot self-attest production guard behavior.
Retained; nonexposure remains necessary but does not establish independent guard validation.
Retained; rendered delayed visibility remains necessary but does not close all staged-substage ordering.
Retained; finite-relay claim gating remains necessary but must become clause-specific.
Retained as a future anti-overclaim obligation only; it is not a sufficient or presently executable organism experiment.

agreements: C11 must remain a governance-bound, fixed-policy supplied-memory precursor and cannot receive DREAM, SLEEP, LoRA, self-write, online-learning, recurrence, lifetime, generalization, or whole-organism credit.
Human authority remains staged: deliberation, source authoring, exact-byte review, exact-byte ratification, preparation, and execution are distinct and never auto-promote.
The 18-condition/501-slot roster, finite resource ceiling, visibility exclusions, two-source boundary provenance intent, and 32-record registry must not drift.
A pass projection must be narrow and governance metadata must not become an actor/model-visible channel.
The future organism requires grounded episodes, goal-blind DREAM, independent support or revocation, validated SLEEP transport, goal-conditioned THINK, and a later eligibility boundary.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: controlling predecessor bytes are omitted and the configured 15,000-character cap prevents fresh roles from receiving complete controlling sources.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Rework the workflow/state so every controlling artifact is directly bound and delivered in full; either add the omitted candidate-v3 and closure-v2 bytes or fully restate and expressly supersede them. Register a context-completeness falsifier; V11-WORKFLOW-CONTEXT-AUTHORITY-01 covers only part of this requirement.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the controllerless description conflicts with the executable singleton guard in plan v2.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Choose and bind one guard identity, media type, custody surface, plan membership, census path, review preimage, and runtime actor across all successor bytes; V11-AUTHENTICATED-GUARD-OBSERVATIONS-04 is only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the guard is presently the sole arbiter of its grammar and nonexposure behavior.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add an independently authored and reviewed reference interpreter or proof-producing checker that does not import or trust the guard and validates grammar, closure, mutations, projection, and failure behavior. No registered test fully covers this; tests 04-06 cover portions only.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: preparation/materialization-adjacent operations are not mechanically ordered after a same-grant passing guard receipt.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a substage-zero causal-ordering falsifier that rejects every import, preparation, materialization, checker, fixture, or candidate-consumer event lacking the exact passing guard receipt as predecessor. No registered test fully covers this; V11-AUTHENTICATED-GUARD-OBSERVATIONS-04 is closest.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the stated DREAM-to-SLEEP edge conflates supported and revoked proposals.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Specify that only independently supported proposals may enter validated SLEEP transport; revoked proposals must be excluded or represented only as explicit invalidation metadata under a separately defined rule. FUTURE-ORGANISM-CAUSAL-CHAIN-09 is only a partial future constraint.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: no exact public-event, chronological, support-independence, or feedback eligibility rule operationalizes recurrence.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a later organism protocol with exact event, chronological cut, support-independence, contamination exclusion, and THINK-outcome-to-later-DREAM eligibility rules. FUTURE-ORGANISM-CAUSAL-CHAIN-09 is insufficiently operational.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: an aggregate receipt cannot establish independent connected-route, calibration, delayed-carrier, scratch, feedback, and baseline clauses.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind clause-specific endpoints, receipt dependencies, reducers, finite denominators, withdrawals, and negative dispositions. V11-FINITE-RELAY-CLAIM-GATE-08 is the closest existing test but does not fully cover this.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: C11 has no self-authored grounded write, persistence, or later-action causal path.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep online-learning, retention, self-write, and organism claims excluded; require a separately ratified intervention on persistent write while holding experience and later goal fixed. FUTURE-ORGANISM-CAUSAL-CHAIN-09 is only a future boundary.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the future causal-chain item names ordering but lacks the ablations and substrate controls necessary for an organism claim.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Rework a separate future protocol with registered edge accumulation, recurrence removal, bridge removal, scale, lifetime, retention, and matched text-versus-LoRA transport tests. FUTURE-ORGANISM-CAUSAL-CHAIN-09 remains necessary but is not sufficient.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: independent support and memory provenance do not exclude paraphrase, compression, synthetic re-expression, repeated use, or shared ancestry.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define an exact future independent-support provenance rule tracing each DREAM proposal to grounded roots and rejecting non-independent synthetic or shared-ancestry support. FUTURE-ORGANISM-CAUSAL-CHAIN-09 is only partial coverage.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: one fixed topology and policy cannot establish scaling, population, model, lifetime, or topology generalization.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Retain finite-census-only reporting and require a separately preregistered split/scale/lifetime protocol before any scaling claim. V11-FINITE-RELAY-CLAIM-GATE-08 and FUTURE-ORGANISM-CAUSAL-CHAIN-09 only constrain the boundary.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: governance and software conformance cannot validate scientific construct meaning.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve governance evidence as non-scientific and require later independent evidence-to-claim review under a separately ratified scientific protocol. V11-FINITE-RELAY-CLAIM-GATE-08 cannot itself supply scientific approval.

disagreements.issue: Whether the hash-bound workflow supplies every controlling byte to fresh reviewers.

positions.position: Transitive references and the configured context suffice.
Omitted controlling artifacts and 15,000-character truncation prevent direct, complete fresh-context review.

resolution.rationale: The critic position controls because a digest reference cannot substitute for visible normative bytes.
resolution.required_change: Create a newly bound workflow/state with direct full-byte controlling sources or complete superseding restatements and a dedicated completeness falsifier.

disagreements.issue: Whether controllerless and executable singleton-guard descriptions are operationally identical.

positions.position: The descriptions represent one equivalent guard.
They imply different executable status, custody, review, and census surfaces.

resolution.rationale: One identity must be bound before any review or execution chain can be evaluated.
resolution.required_change: Select one guard identity consistently across all controlling artifacts and register cross-artifact equality coverage.

disagreements.issue: Whether guard self-attestation establishes conformance and nonexposure.

positions.position: The guard's own authenticated observation and matcher receipts establish conformance.
A self-attesting guard cannot independently validate its grammar, closure, or output behavior.

resolution.rationale: The required independent observer is absent from the registered suite.
resolution.required_change: Add a separately authored and reviewed reference interpreter or proof-producing checker; this requires a repaired registry.

disagreements.issue: Whether the guard is causally prior to all candidate-consuming preparation activity.

positions.position: Substage zero wording sufficiently orders the guard.
The proposal lacks a falsifier rejecting earlier import, materialization, checker, fixture, or candidate-consumer events.

resolution.rationale: Stage names do not prove causal ordering.
resolution.required_change: Add an exact same-grant substage-ordering test and make all later consumers depend on its passing receipt.

disagreements.issue: Whether revoked DREAM proposals can reach SLEEP transport.

positions.position: Supported/revoked proposals can reach the DREAM-to-SLEEP edge.
Only validated supported semantics may be transported; revoked proposals must be excluded or isolated invalidation metadata.

resolution.rationale: Transporting revoked semantics contradicts the stated validation boundary.
resolution.required_change: Specify supported-only transport and a separate invalidation representation, if any, in a future protocol.

disagreements.issue: Whether prose-level deferred edges adequately define organism recurrence and future-memory provenance.

positions.position: Deferred graph edges preserve the thesis without operational C11 effect.
The future protocol still lacks exact eligibility, chronology, independent-support provenance, and feedback admission rules.

resolution.rationale: The relay must not be mistaken for recurrence, and the future recurrence design remains underdefined.
resolution.required_change: Bind a separate organism protocol defining eligible grounded events, support independence, revocation, persistence, and feedback boundaries.

disagreements.issue: Whether an omnibus relay gate can support multiple mechanistically distinct claims.

positions.position: A finite aggregate claim gate is a sufficient release envelope.
Each clause requires its own endpoints, reducers, dependencies, and withdrawal rule.

resolution.rationale: Aggregate protocol completion cannot establish separate causal clauses.
resolution.required_change: Register clause-specific releases and negative dispositions in a repaired proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether C11 can evidence online learning or self-written persistent memory.

positions.position: C11 preserves the future organism thesis.
C11 has no self-authored write-to-later-action path and can only constrain overclaiming.

resolution.rationale: The supplied relay is not an online learner.
resolution.required_change: Maintain exclusion and require a separate write-intervention causal protocol for any learning claim.

disagreements.issue: Whether FUTURE-ORGANISM-CAUSAL-CHAIN-09 is sufficient for a future organism claim.

positions.position: The causal-chain test bounds future organism evidence.
It lacks necessary ablations, matched transport controls, scale, lifetime, retention, and continued-improvement design.

resolution.rationale: The registered item is necessary as an anti-overclaim constraint but not a complete experiment.
resolution.required_change: Create a separately ratified, claim-specific organism benchmark and test registry.

disagreements.issue: Whether the finite fixed-policy census can support scaling or generalization.

positions.position: The finite relay is a useful bounded assay.
It cannot support topology, model, population, memory-scale, lifetime, or scaling generalization.

resolution.rationale: Both positions are compatible only under a strict within-suite claim ceiling.
resolution.required_change: Retain exact finite-census reporting and require future preregistered scale/lifetime work for broader claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether governance conformance can constitute scientific approval.

positions.position: Governance closure is a prerequisite for later source and relay work.
Governance and checker conformance are not construct validation or scientific evidence.

resolution.rationale: Governance gates can constrain authorization and leakage but cannot prove the scientific construct.
resolution.required_change: Preserve governance evidence as non-scientific and require separate independent scientific evidence-to-claim review.

questions: Will Rohin require a repaired newly hash-bound chain that directly exposes all controlling bytes, resolves one guard identity, adds independent guard conformance and substage-ordering tests, and retains the supplied-memory claim ceiling?
Will Rohin require a separately ratified future organism protocol before any online-learning, recurrence, LoRA, scaling, or whole-organism claim?

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: organism edges are deferred conceptual relations, and their eligibility/provenance requirements remain unresolved.
Accepted: aggregate relay completion cannot substitute for clause-specific attribution and withdrawal.
Accepted: the future item is not a C11 experiment and remains insufficient as a future organism test.
Accepted: direct complete controlling bytes are absent under the bound cap and context list.
Accepted: controllerless and executable guard identities are materially distinct.
Accepted: revoked proposals cannot enter validated SLEEP transport as semantics.
Accepted: causal ordering alone does not operationalize the required organism ablations and controls.
